description:
Activate Sydri for {1} of any color due to Chromatic Orrery, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature.
Activate Chromatic Orrery for {5}, drawing at least 3 cards (more if you control permanents with the colors you're missing).
Tolarian Kraken triggers 3 times, targeting Chromatic Orrery with all 3 triggers.
Pay for the first trigger with {1}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
In response to the second trigger, tap Chromatic Orrery for 5 {C}.
Spend {1} for the seonc trigger, untapping Chromatic Orrery again.
In response to the third trigger, tap Chromatic Orrery for 5 {C}.
Pay {1} for the last Tolarian Kraken ability, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2 for infinite card draw and Near-infinite mana.
